subject: Viadyn trial bridge & packaging workflow
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@viadyn.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short trial extension + packaging question

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the fast onboarding this week. We completed the integration tests but our model-retraining pipeline slipped (two infra tickets) and the team is asking for a short runway so we can validate throughput + latency at scale.

Can Redwood do a 3-week extension to the timeboxed evaluation? If not, what are the smallest bridge options you can offer (fixed credit bucket, accelerated top-up, or short-term seat change)? Our procurement lead (procurement@viadyn.com) will need a short amendment or SOW + net-30 terms.

Also: we want to avoid a full price discussion yet — curious about a modest discount on a paid renewal if we convert within 30 days post-trial. Is that something you can offer, or do you only do credits/time additions?

Attaching a short usage snapshot so you can see where we landed.

—Alex
Alex Kim
Head of ML Platform, Viadyn
alex.kim@viadyn.ai

Attachment: Viadyn_Eval_Usage_Summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@viadyn.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + packaging question

Alex — great to see the snapshot, and thanks for the heads up. We can support a short runway; two pragmatic options below (keeps procurement minimal):

1) Time extension (fast): 2-week trial extension, no change to license, plus a 20% credit on the first monthly invoice if you convert to a paid plan within 30 days. No amendment required — we can do a one-line PO addendum.

2) Bridge credit (predictable): 60 compute-hours bridge token pack (prepaid credits) usable during a fixed 3-week window. If you convert within 30 days we’ll apply a 10% bridge credit bonus toward your first invoice. Requires a short amendment or a single-line SOW.

I attached a one-pager that compares both (pricing bands + what counts toward conversion). If procurement needs net-30, loop Laura and we’ll get finance to issue an invoice instead of charging the card.

Which do you prefer? If you want the full 3-week runway we can take option 2 and expand to 90 hours — I’ll check approval for that on our side.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: Bridge_Offer_OnePager.xlsx (xlsx); Viadyn_Eval_Usage_Summary.pdf (pdf)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear options. Two quick clarifications from our side: we actually need the full 3-week runway (team calendar + external demo commitments are locked to that window). Option 2 sounds good if you can expand to 90 compute-hours and confirm the conversion bonus.

Procurement flagged that any addendum should be DocuSigned (their standard), and they prefer net-30 invoicing. Samir (cc) is our procurement contact and will take the amendment through approval once you share the DocuSign link + the one-pager with exact SKU and invoice instructions.

Also: can you confirm the bridge pack will automatically drop into the same project and not create a new billing entity? We want usage to count toward conversion metrics without reconfiguration.

Appreciate the help —
Alex

Alex / Samir / procurement team —

We can do option 2 expanded to 90 compute-hours for the 3-week window, with a 15% credit applied to the first monthly invoice if Viadyn converts within 30 days. That compromise reflects the extra runway while keeping billing clean.

What I have attached now: Bridge_Offer_OnePager.xlsx (finalized SKUs + pricing), and a DocuSign packet to amend the original evaluation (link below). The bridge pack will be provisioned into your existing project (no new billing tenant) and usage will count toward the conversion metric; I confirmed that with our platform team.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/bridge/VD-2389-amendment
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1000/deal/VD-2389

Next steps from us:
- Ben: send DocuSign + one-pager (done)
- Samir / procurement: sign amendment and share PO or invoice instructions
- Laura: finance to issue net-30 invoice if requested
- Marissa: CS will schedule a success plan and a check-in midway through the bridge

If procurement wants alternate wording on net-30 or invoicing, loop Laura and I’ll escalate.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
